dialogues.speaker: Murakami
dialogues.text: My, my, if it isn't Miss Kamisato's friend. Welcome!

dialogues.speaker: Murakami
dialogues.text: Ever since you brought Miss Kamisato here last time, we've been having more and more people come to try our Sakura Mochi and Egg Rolls!

dialogues.speaker: Murakami
dialogues.text: I'll definitely take good care of you and Miss Kamisato the next time you two come again.

dialogues.speaker: Murakami
dialogues.text: Say, have you mastered the Sakura Mochi recipe just yet?
